Rangers plan January exit for Cifuentes - gossip
- Published
Rangers hope to offload Ecuador midfielder Jose Cifuentes, 27, in January - with American, Mexican and Turkish clubs interested. (Daily Record - subscription required, external)
The £6m gamble on Haissem Hassan sums up a recruitment problem Celtic cannot now ignore. (The Herald), external
Motherwell defender Jake Girdwood-Reich has not seen a better goalkeeping performance than team-mate Alex Paulsen's in Saturday's 2-1 defeat by Rangers. (Daily Record - subscription required, external)

Scotland supporters urge Oli McBurnie to replicate his Hull City form with the national side after his Sunday double against Brighton. (Sun, external)
